snippet.title: はっぴ～ぶり～でぃんぐ / Happy Breeding - Opening Movie
snippet.description:
This is the opening of はっぴ～ぶり～でぃんぐ / Happy Breeding, an eroge released in 2002 by Purple software & Silver Co., Ltd.

Directed by: Matsutake Tokuyuki
Song: "Koi ni Narimasu You ni" performed by Kaibara Elena, Kawabe Noriko, Nagasaki Tsukuyo and Sugisawa Yuka
